scripts.typecheck: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const dirs = ['src/engine', 'src/game', 'src/content']; const has = dirs.some((d) => fs.existsSync(d) && fs.readdirSync(d, { recursive: true }).some((f) => /\.(m?js|ts)$/.test(f))); if (has) process.exit(spawnSync('tsc', ['--noEmit'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status ?? 1); console.log('typecheck: no files in src/engine, src/game, src/content yet');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run smoke
